name: StayEasy
title: Riad rates for StayEasy, live from Booking.com
intro: One request with a property name and two dates returns what Booking.com quotes for that stay right now: total price, room type, review score and the link. Below is that request run once on Riad Kniza for December 10 to 12, in dirhams.
resultLine: Riad Kniza, 2 nights from Dec 10: MAD 7,868 total (Royal Suite), review score 9.4 from 954 reviews.

fanout.title: A week of check-in dates for one riad
fanout.note: The REST API prices one stay per request, so a rate calendar is one request per check-in date. Seven dates is seven requests; PRO allows 25 a minute, so a 30-property set over a week of dates takes about 9 minutes.
fanout.code:
for d in 10 11 12 13 14 15 16; do
  curl -s https://api.flightpowers.com/v1/hotels/by-name \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "x-api-key: $RAPIDAPI_KEY" \
    -d "{\"hotel_name\":\"Riad Kniza Marrakech\",\"checkin_date\":\"2026-12-$d\",\"checkout_date\":\"2026-12-$((d+2))\",\"adults\":2,\"currency\":\"MAD\"}"
done

mcp.prompt: Price Riad Kniza in Marrakech for every 2-night stay checking in between December 10 and December 16, 2026, in MAD, and tell me which check-in date is cheapest.
mcp.note: The hotels MCP server takes a check-in range and a number of nights in one call, so the whole week above is a single prompt.

extras: Add price_as_seen_from (a two-letter country code, MCP) or proxy_country (REST) to see the rate a guest in that country is quoted.
The Google Hotels Live API is a separate listing (PRO $10 for 2,500 requests) and returns the sites Google lists for a hotel, each with its price.
